leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a web worker with a separate JavaScript file for background execution
Configure message event listeners to handle communication between the main thread and worker
Implement a calculation function within the web worker that processes data received via messages
Construct a postMessage call from the main thread to send data to the web worker
Manipulate the DOM to display calculation results returned from the web worker
Integrate error handling for web worker loading failures and runtime errors
Control the web worker lifecycle by properly terminating it when calculations are complete
lessonTitle: Build web worker integration for expensive calculations
